name: @vssaros/dsh-ide
description: VsSaros IDE capability module for DeepSeek Harness: exposes IDE context and navigation (diagnostics / selection read-only; open_file / reveal / show_diff display-only, default not stealing focus) as dsh tools, executed through the control bridge reverse channel (Host -> VsSaros). Declares vssaros.ideCapabilities, which is what the VsSaros side authorizes against.
